position_advice.en: 60-65% (Shift chips from front row to back row: from NVDA to DELL, from mega-cap growth to cyclical value. Wait for PCE on Friday. Hot PCE = 3-5% pullback is buying opportunity. Cold PCE = bull continues but space limited)

condition.en: Expanding but structural turning point forming
condition.zh: 扩张但结构性拐点正在形成

summary.en: Liquidity is still expanding: TGA release exceeds Warsh QT, net effect remains positive (+$42B WoW). Net liquidity up +$230B from April bottom. However, ON RRP is essentially zero with no buffers remaining. The structural turning point is expected within 6-8 weeks as Warsh's QT accelerates.
summary.zh: 流动性仍在扩张：TGA 释放大于 Warsh 缩表，净效果仍为正（周环比 +$42B）。净流动性从 4 月底部回升 +$230B。然而，ON RRP 基本归零，已无缓冲。随着 Warsh 缩表加速，结构性拐点预计将在 6-8 周内到来。

fed_balance_sheet_change.zh: -149 亿美元（周环比）——Warsh 缩表持续

rrp_note.en: Essentially zero — no shock absorber remaining
rrp_note.zh: 基本归零——系统已无减震器

tga_note.en: -$57.3B WoW — TGA release > Warsh QT, net still positive
tga_note.zh: 周环比 -$57.3B——TGA 释放 > Warsh 缩表，净效果仍正

net_liquidity_change.zh: 周环比 +$42B——从 4 月底部回升 +$230B

details.en: The liquidity engine is still running but the structural picture is deteriorating. Warsh's inaugural speech explicitly called for a 'reform-oriented Fed' with less market backstop. June FOMC (6/16-17) will reveal the full QT path. If monthly QT reaches $50-100B, the current net expansion reverses within 6-8 weeks. With ON RRP exhausted, there are no shock absorbers left.
details.zh: 流动性引擎仍在运转，但结构性图景正在恶化。Warsh 的就职演说明确呼吁'改革导向的 Fed'，减少市场后盾。6 月 FOMC（6/16-17）将揭示完整缩表路径。如果月度缩表达到 $50-100B，当前净扩张将在 6-8 周内逆转。随着 ON RRP 耗尽，已无减震器。

reason.en: Net liquidity +$42B/wk, up $230B from bottom. 30Y eased from 5.19% to 5.06%. But Warsh QT -$14.9B/wk ongoing, ON RRP at zero with no buffer remaining.
reason.zh: 净流动性 +$42B/周，从底部回升 $230B。30Y 从 5.19% 回落至 5.06%。但 Warsh 缩表 -$14.9B/周持续，ON RRP 归零无缓冲。

reason.en: NVDA $81.6B revenue +85% monster quarter, stock dropped 1.90% (4th consecutive beat-and-sell). DELL +16.77% same day — AI supply chain rotation. PPI +6% accelerating inflation compresses non-tech margins. Financials YTD -2.7% only negative sector.
reason.zh: NVDA $81.6B 营收 +85% 怪物级季报，股价跌 1.90%（连续第 4 次 beat-and-sell）。DELL 同日 +16.77%——AI 供应链轮动。PPI +6% 通胀加速压缩非科技利润率。金融 YTD -2.7% 唯一负收益板块。

reason.en: 56.37% above 200DMA (+1.2ppt). Russell +0.91% leading. Direction correct but still below 60% healthy threshold. Quantum stocks RGTI +20%, QBTS +14% speculative bubble signals.
reason.zh: 56.37% 在 200 日均线上方（+1.2%）。Russell +0.91% 领涨。方向正确但仍低于 60% 健康线。量子股 RGTI +20%、QBTS +14% 投机泡沫信号。

reason.en: S&P 7,473 on 8-week winning streak at ATH. Dow 50,580 ATH. VIX 16.70. Technical composite 88.22 near extreme (90+ = tops historically).
reason.zh: S&P 7,473 连涨 8 周处于 ATH。Dow 50,580 ATH。VIX 16.70。技术复合指标 88.22 接近极端（历史上 90+ = 顶部）。

trading_summary.en: 63.75 — Moderate Bullish. Liquidity still injecting, trend still up — don't fight it. But Warsh drew first blood on day one. NVDA delivered the greatest quarter in human history, market didn't buy it — 4th time. When the best company's best report card can't move the stock, pricing has hit the ceiling. Don't short — liquidity engine still running. But shift chips from front row to back row: from NVDA to DELL, from mega-cap growth to cyclical value. 60% position, wait for PCE. If hot — 30Y retests 5.20%, 3-5% pullback is buying opportunity. If cold — bull continues but space is limited.
trading_summary.zh: 63.75分，Moderate Bullish。流动性仍在注入，趋势仍然向上——不跟趋势作对。但Warsh第一天就动刀了。NVDA交出人类历史上最强季报，市场不买账，连续第4次。当最好的公司最好的成绩单都推不动股价，定价已经到了极限。不做空——流动性引擎还在转。但把筹码从前排换到后排：从NVDA换到DELL，从大盘成长换到周期价值。60%仓位，等PCE。如果热——30Y重测5.20%，回调3-5%是加仓机会。如果冷——牛市继续但空间有限。

trading_quote: Shift chips from front row to back row. NVDA pricing has hit the ceiling. Wait for PCE.

exchange_flow_detail.en: YTD -30%, 52-week range $60,074-$126,198. Small bounce but structural divergence from equity ATH persists.
exchange_flow_detail.zh: YTD -30%，52 周范围 $60,074-$126,198。小幅反弹但与股市 ATH 的结构性背离持续。

analysis.en: BTC at $77,088 (+0.45%), YTD -30%. The 52-week range ($60K-$126K) illustrates the severity of the drawdown from all-time highs. As a leading indicator, BTC's persistent weakness relative to equity ATH remains an unresolved macro warning signal.
analysis.zh: BTC 报 $77,088（+0.45%），YTD -30%。52 周范围（$60K-$126K）说明了从历史高点回撤的严重程度。作为领先指标，BTC 相对于股市 ATH 的持续弱势仍是一个未解决的宏观警告信号。

analysis.en: Gold at $4,523/oz, slight pullback. Structural bull case remains intact given fiscal concerns and geopolitical risks. The gold-equity ATH coexistence continues to signal underlying fragility.
analysis.zh: 黄金报 $4,523/盎司，小幅回落。考虑到财政担忧和地缘政治风险，结构性牛市逻辑依然完整。黄金与股市同处高位的共存持续发出潜在脆弱性信号。

detail.en: Composite technical indicator at 88.22 — historically, readings above 90 correspond to market tops. 8-week winning streak + RSI 68 + MACD sell signal. Upside compressed, mean reversion probability rising. PCE on Friday is the binary trigger.
detail.zh: 复合技术指标 88.22——历史上，读数超过 90 对应市场顶部。连涨 8 周 + RSI 68 + MACD 卖出信号。上行空间被压缩，均值回归概率上升。周五 PCE 是二元触发器。

title.en: Warsh reform-oriented Fed — no market backstop
title.zh: Warsh 改革导向 Fed——减少市场后盾

detail.en: First week QT at -$14.9B is just the appetizer. Inaugural speech explicitly called for a 'reform-oriented Fed' with less market backstop. June FOMC (6/16-17) will reveal the full QT path. If monthly QT reaches $50-100B, net liquidity expansion reverses within 6-8 weeks.
detail.zh: 第一周缩表 -$14.9B 只是开胃菜。就职演说明确呼吁'改革导向的 Fed'，减少市场后盾。6 月 FOMC（6/16-17）揭示完整路径。如果月缩达 $50-100B，净流动性扩张将在 6-8 周内逆转。

title.en: NVDA paradox deepens — pricing saturation confirmed
title.zh: NVDA 悖论加深——定价饱和确认

detail.en: NVDA delivered the greatest quarter in human history ($81.6B revenue +85%), yet the stock dropped 1.90% — the 4th consecutive beat-and-sell. But DELL surged 16.77% the same day. Money is not leaving AI; it's rotating from overpriced leaders to cheaper supply chain entry points. This is a 'change horses' signal confirming pricing saturation at the top.
detail.zh: NVDA 交出了人类历史上最强季报（营收 $81.6B，增长 85%），但股价跌 1.90%——连续第 4 次 beat-and-sell。但 DELL 同日飙升 16.77%。资金不是离开 AI，而是从定价过满的龙头轮动到更便宜的供应链入口。这是'换马'信号，确认龙头定价饱和。

title.en: Active. BTC -30% YTD vs Equity ATH. NVDA 4th beat-and-sell. Technical composite 88.22. PPI +6% vs Equity ATH. Quantum bubble.
title.zh: 活跃。BTC -30% YTD vs 股市 ATH。NVDA 第 4 次 beat-and-sell。技术复合 88.22。PPI +6% vs 股市 ATH。量子泡沫。

detail.en: Multiple divergences remain active. BTC at YTD lows while equities are at ATH is a 6-8 week leading indicator. NVDA's 4th consecutive beat-and-sell confirms AI growth is fully priced. Technical composite at 88.22 signals mean-reversion risk. PPI +6% accelerating inflation diverges from the equity ATH narrative. Quantum stock speculation (RGTI +20%, QBTS +14%) signals unhealthy late-cycle behavior.
detail.zh: 多重背离依然活跃。BTC 处于年内低点而股市处于 ATH 是 6-8 周的领先指标。NVDA 连续第 4 次 beat-and-sell 确认 AI 增长已完全定价。技术复合指标 88.22 发出均值回归风险信号。PPI +6% 通胀加速与股市 ATH 叙事背离。量子股投机（RGTI +20%、QBTS +14%）发出不健康的周期末期行为信号。
